command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime
H=e8336eeac4f43f3808b44b5bb5859e010f8a7b26
DEST="$ROOT/releases/$H"
STAGE="$ROOT/releases/.stage-$H-777-2035"
SRC="$ROOT/releases/49d9bb023933ee6383433e5206d4148b8082dcae"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,pathlib,sqlite3
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); lock=root/'state/omega-supervisor.lock'; db=root/'data/omega_unified.db'
if lock.exists():
 raw=lock.read_text().strip()
 try:
  os.kill(int(raw),0); raise SystemExit('ABORT_LIVE_SUPERVISOR:'+raw)
 except ProcessLookupError: pass
 except ValueError: raise SystemExit('ABORT_BAD_SUPERVISOR_LOCK')
if db.exists():
 con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True); names={r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}
 if 'relay_ledger' in names:
  n=con.execute("select count(*) from relay_ledger where state='DISPATCHING'").fetchone()[0]
  if n: raise SystemExit(f'ABORT_INFLIGHT_RELAY:{n}')
 if 'effect_intent' in names:
  n=con.execute("select count(*) from effect_intent where dispatch_state='DISPATCHING'").fetchone()[0]
  if n: raise SystemExit(f'ABORT_INFLIGHT_EFFECT:{n}')
 con.close()
print('CUTOVER_PREFLIGHT=PASS')
PY
if [ ! -d "$DEST/.git" ]; then
  test -d "$SRC/.git"
  test ! -e "$STAGE"
  git clone --quiet "$SRC" "$STAGE"
  git -C "$STAGE" fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin "$H"
  git -C "$STAGE" checkout --quiet --detach "$H"
  test "$(git -C "$STAGE" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$H"
  mv "$STAGE" "$DEST"
fi
test "$(git -C "$DEST" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$H"
cd "$DEST"
python3 -m compileall -q omega tests
python3 -m pytest -q
echo RELEASE_TESTS=PASS
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,pathlib,datetime
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); h='e8336eeac4f43f3808b44b5bb5859e010f8a7b26'; dest=root/'releases'/h; cur=root/'current'
prev=str(cur.resolve()) if cur.exists() else None
receipts=root/'activation_receipts'; receipts.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
t=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
(receipts/'777-e8336eea-pre.json').write_text(json.dumps({'previous_release':prev,'target_release':str(dest),'target_head':h,'at':t},indent=2)+'\n')
tmp=root/'.current-777-e8336eea'; os.symlink(dest,tmp); os.replace(tmp,cur)
meta={'omega_head':h,'release_dir':str(dest),'activated_at':t,'source':'777_convergence','previous_release':prev}
m=root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json.tmp-777'; m.write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n'); os.replace(m,root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json')
print('CURRENT_POINTER',cur.resolve()); print('PREVIOUS_POINTER',prev)
PY
mkdir -p "$ROOT/state/logs"
nohup env PYTHONPATH="$DEST" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$ROOT/state" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$DEST" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$ROOT/data/omega_unified.db" OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG="$DEST/config/organ_router.json" OMEGA_AUTONOMY_POLICY="$DEST/config/autonomy_policy.json" OMEGA_CARRIER_REPO="$ROOT/carrier_repo" OMEGA_OUTER_SPOOL="$ROOT/state/outer_bridge" python3 -m omega.supervisor_outer --runtime-root "$ROOT/state" --repo-root "$DEST" >>"$ROOT/state/logs/supervisor-outer-launch.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
echo SUPERVISOR_LAUNCH_PID=$!
sleep 7
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,os
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); p=root/'state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json'
if not p.exists(): raise SystemExit('SUPERVISOR_STATUS_MISSING')
d=json.loads(p.read_text()); children=d.get('children') or {}; dead={k:v for k,v in children.items() if not v.get('alive')}
print('SUPERVISOR_STATUS',json.dumps({'schema':d.get('schema'),'transport_boundary':d.get('transport_boundary'),'pid':d.get('pid'),'repo_root':d.get('repo_root'),'children':{k:v.get('alive') for k,v in children.items()}},separators=(',',':')))
if dead: raise SystemExit('SUPERVISOR_CHILD_DEAD:'+json.dumps(dead,separators=(',',':')))
pid=int(d['pid']); os.kill(pid,0)
meta=json.loads((root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json').read_text()); assert meta.get('omega_head')=='e8336eeac4f43f3808b44b5bb5859e010f8a7b26'
print('OMEGA_SANDBOX_SUPERVISOR=LIVE')
PY
